parameter.name: phoneNumber
parameter.label: Phone Number
parameter.description: Phone number of the Electra Smart app account in local format, for example 0521234567. International prefixes are converted automatically.

parameter.name: otp
parameter.label: One-time Password
parameter.description: Code received by SMS after requesting a one-time password. It is cleared automatically once the sign-in succeeded.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often the state of the air conditioners is polled from the Electra cloud.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: Identifier of the air conditioner. It is filled in automatically by discovery.
